claims.text: This excerpt shows a series of warnings and info messages from a Zookeeper QuorumPeer with myid=1, indicating that it is having trouble connecting to other peers, specifically those with ids 2 and 3, at their respective election addresses.
The warnings specify that it cannot open a channel to these peers, while the info messages note notification timeouts of 60000.
The repeated warnings about peer 2 at address /10.10.34.12:3888 suggest a persistent connection issue with that peer.
